ActionManagerClient.luau.description: Holds single toggleable actions (like a tool system). This is legacy code and probably should not be used in new games. Public entry points include `ActionManager.new`, `ActionManager.StopCurrentAction`, `ActionManager.ActivateAction`, `ActionManager.GetAction`, `ActionManager.GetActions`, `ActionManager.AddAction`, `ActionManager.Destroy`.

BaseAction.luau.description: BaseAction state for [ActionManager]. Public entry points include `BaseAction.new`, `BaseAction.GetName`, `BaseAction.GetActivationMode`, `BaseAction.GetData`, `BaseAction.ToggleActivate`, `BaseAction.IsActive`, `BaseAction.Deactivate`, `BaseAction.Activate`.
